prop segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    c != d
    forall p cart(R, R):
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, b)
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, c, d)
        p != a
        =>:
            p = b
    forall p cart(R, R):
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, b)
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, c, d)
        p != c
        =>:
            p = d

thm segment_endpoint_condition_excludes_crossing:
    ? forall a, b, c, d, p cart(R, R):
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, b)
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, c, d)
        p != a
        p != b
        =>:
            not $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d)
    by contra:
        ? not $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d)
        $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d)
        by def $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d)
        p = b
        impossible p != b
stores:
forall a, b, c, d, p cart(R, R):
    $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, b)
    $f5::is_on_segment(p, c, d)
    p != a
    p != b
    =>:
        not $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d)

prop is_simple_polygonal_cycle(n N+, vertices fn (k Z) cart(R, R)):
    n >= 3
    vertices(n) = vertices(0)
    forall k Z:
        0 <= k
        k < n
        =>:
            vertices(k) != vertices((k + 1))
    forall left_index, right_index Z:
        0 <= left_index
        left_index < right_index
        right_index < n
        =>:
            vertices(left_index) != vertices(right_index)
    forall left_index, right_index Z:
        0 <= left_index
        left_index < n
        0 <= right_index
        right_index < n
        left_index != right_index
        =>:
            $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(vertices(left_index), vertices((left_index + 1)), vertices(right_index), vertices((right_index + 1)))

thm strict_edge_crossing_excludes_simple_polygonal_cycle:
    ? forall n N+, vertices fn (k Z) cart(R, R), left_index, right_index Z, crossing cart(R, R):
        0 <= left_index
        left_index < n
        0 <= right_index
        right_index < n
        left_index != right_index
        $f5::is_on_segment(crossing, vertices(left_index), vertices((left_index + 1)))
        $f5::is_on_segment(crossing, vertices(right_index), vertices((right_index + 1)))
        crossing != vertices(left_index)
        crossing != vertices((left_index + 1))
        =>:
            not $f5::is_simple_polygonal_cycle(n, vertices)
    by contra:
        ? not $f5::is_simple_polygonal_cycle(n, vertices)
        $f5::is_simple_polygonal_cycle(n, vertices)
        by def $f5::is_simple_polygonal_cycle(n, vertices)
        $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(vertices(left_index), vertices((left_index + 1)), vertices(right_index), vertices((right_index + 1)))
        release thm segment_endpoint_condition_excludes_crossing(vertices(left_index), vertices((left_index + 1)), vertices(right_index), vertices((right_index + 1)), crossing)
        impossible $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(vertices(left_index), vertices((left_index + 1)), vertices(right_index), vertices((right_index + 1)))
stores:
forall n N+, vertices fn (k Z) cart(R, R), left_index, right_index Z, crossing cart(R, R):

    crossing != vertices(left_index)
    crossing != vertices((left_index + 1))
    =>:

thm segment_endpoint_condition_gives_common_endpoint:
    ? forall a, b, c, d, p cart(R, R):
        $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d)
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, b)
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, c, d)
        =>:
            p = a or p = b
            p = c or p = d
    by def $f5::segments_meet_only_at_common_endpoints(a, b, c, d)
    by cases:
        ? p = a or p = b
        case p = a:
            p = a
        case p != a:
            p = b
    by cases:
        ? p = c or p = d
        case p = c:
            p = c
        case p != c:
            p = d

    $f5::is_on_segment(p, c, d)
    =>:
        p = a or p = b
        p = c or p = d

thm proper_triangle_adjacent_segments_intersect_at_vertex:
    ? forall a, b, c, p cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, c)
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, b)
        $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, c)
        =>:
            p = a
    by def $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, b)
    obtain u from exist u R st {0 <= u, u <= 1, p(1) = (((1 - u) * a(1)) + (u * b(1))), p(2) = (((1 - u) * a(2)) + (u * b(2)))}
    by def $f5::is_on_segment(p, a, c)
    obtain v from exist v R st {0 <= v, v <= 1, p(1) = (((1 - v) * a(1)) + (v * c(1))), p(2) = (((1 - v) * a(2)) + (v * c(2)))}
    ((a(1) + (u * (b(1) - a(1)))) + (0 * (c(1) - a(1)))) = (((1 - u) * a(1)) + (u * b(1))) = p(1) = (((1 - v) * a(1)) + (v * c(1))) = ((a(1) + (0 * (b(1) - a(1)))) + (v * (c(1) - a(1))))
    ((a(2) + (u * (b(2) - a(2)))) + (0 * (c(2) - a(2)))) = (((1 - u) * a(2)) + (u * b(2))) = p(2) = (((1 - v) * a(2)) + (v * c(2))) = ((a(2) + (0 * (b(2) - a(2)))) + (v * (c(2) - a(2))))
    release thm triangle_barycentric_coordinates_unique(a, b, c, u, 0, 0, v)
    u = 0
    v = 0
    p(1) = (((1 - u) * a(1)) + (u * b(1))) = a(1)
    p(2) = (((1 - u) * a(2)) + (u * b(2))) = a(2)
    release thm tuple_equal_from_coordinates(p, (p(1), p(2)))
    release thm tuple_equal_from_coordinates(a, (a(1), a(2)))
    (p(1), p(2)) = (a(1), a(2))
    p = (p(1), p(2)) = (a(1), a(2)) = a

    b != a
    0 <= (1 - t)
    (1 - t) <= 1
    p(1) = (((1 - t) * a(1)) + (t * b(1))) = (((1 - (1 - t)) * b(1)) + ((1 - t) * a(1)))
    p(2) = (((1 - t) * a(2)) + (t * b(2))) = (((1 - (1 - t)) * b(2)) + ((1 - t) * a(2)))
    witness exist u R st {0 <= u, u <= 1, p(1) = (((1 - u) * b(1)) + (u * a(1))), p(2) = (((1 - u) * b(2)) + (u * a(2)))} from (1 - t)

thm proper_triangle_cyclic_rotations:
    ? forall a, b, c cart(R, R):

    ? forall k Z:
        0 <= k
        k < 3

        ? k = 0 or k = 1 or k = 2

            k <= 0

            impossible k != 0
        k >= 1
        by contra:
            ? k > 1
            k <= 1
            k = 1
            impossible k != 1
        k >= 2
        k <= 2

thm three_vertex_triangle_is_simple_polygonal_cycle:
    ? forall vertices fn (k Z) cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(vertices(0), vertices(1), vertices(2))
        vertices(3) = vertices(0)
        =>:
            $f5::is_simple_polygonal_cycle(3, vertices)
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(vertices(0), vertices(1), vertices(2))
    release thm proper_triangle_consecutive_segments_common_endpoint(vertices(0), vertices(1), vertices(2))
    release thm common_endpoint_condition_symmetric(vertices(0), vertices(1), vertices(1), vertices(2))
    release thm common_endpoint_condition_symmetric(vertices(1), vertices(2), vertices(2), vertices(0))
    release thm common_endpoint_condition_symmetric(vertices(2), vertices(0), vertices(0), vertices(1))
    claim:
        ? forall k Z:
            0 <= k
            k < 3
            =>:
                vertices(k) != vertices((k + 1))
        release thm integer_index_below_three_cases(k)
        by cases:
            ? vertices(k) != vertices((k + 1))
            case k = 0:
                (k + 1) = 1
                vertices(k) = vertices(0)
                vertices((k + 1)) = vertices(1)
                vertices(0) != vertices(1)
                vertices(k) != vertices((k + 1))
            case k = 1:
                (k + 1) = 2
                vertices(k) = vertices(1)
                vertices((k + 1)) = vertices(2)
                vertices(1) != vertices(2)
                vertices(k) != vertices((k + 1))
            case k = 2:
                (k + 1) = 3
                vertices(k) = vertices(2)
                vertices((k + 1)) = vertices(3)
                vertices(2) != vertices(3)
                vertices(k) != vertices((k + 1))
    claim:
        ? forall left_index, right_index Z:
            0 <= left_index
            left_index < right_index
            right_index < 3
            =>:
                vertices(left_index) != vertices(right_index)
        left_index < 3
        0 <= right_index
        release thm integer_index_below_three_cases(left_index)
        release thm integer_index_below_three_cases(right_index)
        by contra:
